FOR RENT | Luxury 2-Bedroom apartment at Ivy on the Park – UBC

Modern 2 Bed | 2 Bath | 5th Floor | UBC Wesbrook Village

Live in one of UBC's most desirable luxury residences—Ivy on the Park, located in the heart of Wesbrook Village and surrounded by the natural beauty of Pacific Spirit Regional Park. This bright and contemporary 5th-floor home offers a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and modern design.

Property Features
2 Bedrooms
2 Full Bathrooms
Located on the 5th Floor
Open-concept living and dining area
Floor-to-ceiling windows with abundant natural light
Air Conditioning & Heating
Premium Bosch integrated appliances
Quartz countertops
In-suite washer & dryer
Private balcony
1 Parking Stall
Building Amenities
Concierge
Prime UBC Location
Steps to Wesbrook Village shopping, cafés and restaurants
Walking distance to Save-On-Foods, Shoppers Drug Mart and daily conveniences
Minutes to UBC campus
Surrounded by Pacific Spirit Regional Park trails
Close to University Hill Elementary & Secondary School
Easy transit access to Downtown Vancouver
Lease Details
Available: Immediately / (Insert Available Date)
Rent: $4000 / month
Minimum 1-year lease
No Smoking
No Pets (or Negotiable)
Tenant insurance required
Credit and reference check required

Perfect for UBC faculty, professionals, graduate students, small families, or anyone seeking a quiet, upscale lifestyle in Vancouver's prestigious West Side.
